description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Popup_Picker', which manages the display and processing of popup selection windows in the SuiteCRM application, specifically for selecting records from a module. It includes methods for constructing the popup, generating search and where clauses, and rendering the HTML interface with list views and forms.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Controller class for managing popup selection dialogs within SuiteCRM, handling display logic, form processing, and list view rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Popup_Picker instance, setting up module metadata, and including necessary PHP files based on request parameters.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause for filtering list view entries based on search inputs.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML content for the popup, including search forms, list views, and JavaScript for multi-select handling.
